title: andryala pinnatifida subsp. antonii
intro: Andryala pinnatifida subsp. antonii, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae, is a member of the Andryala genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Andryala pinnatifida subsp. antonii include its use as an anti-diarrheal and anti-spasmodic agent, suggesting its potential in treating gastrointestinal issues and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
